title: HYPGEOMDIST uses asymmetric binomial-mass ratios and misses exact 224/495 by 2 ULP on HYPGEOMDIST(1, 4, 4, 12)
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20131 and 20527, HYPGEOMDIST(sample_s, number_sample, population_s, number_pop) evaluates the 4-argument PMF via asymmetric binomial-mass ratios b(s; k, n/N) * b(n-s; N-k, n/N) / b(n; N, n/N) with stored x87 division and multiplication rather than exact rational factorials. On HYPGEOMDIST(1, 4, 4, 12), Excel build 20131 returns 0.45252525252525244 (0x3fdcf62c7a0d724a), 2 ULP below the correctly rounded binary64 representation of 224/495 (0x3fdcf62c7a0d724c). Matches 2,950/2,954 full-bank and 2/3 pinned rows, with 3 last-bit and 1 numeric (worst 28 ULP) discrepancy still open.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0 build 20131 (2/3 pinned rows in witnesses/HYPGEOMDIST.json), Excel 16.0.20527 (2,950/2,954 full-bank rows, prefix_metadata row 110), and fable52-last-bit.md.

correct.how: Exact rational C(4,1)*C(8,3)/C(12,4) = 224/495 rounded to nearest IEEE-754 binary64

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0 build 20131, Windows, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H; bitness not recorded
Excel 16.0.20527.20088 Current Channel, Windows 64-bit (NT 10.0.26200), x86-64, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, en-ZA

2,950/2,954 full-bank (3 last_bit, 1 numeric) and 2/3 pinned matches
